name: turbine_stodola_offdesign
title: Steam turbine with Stodola's cone law and efficiency characteristic
summary: Gas/steam turbine off-design model: a design point (isentropic efficiency given) supplies the reference values of Stodola's cone law, and an off-design point gets its inlet pressure from the cone law and its isentropic efficiency from a characteristic line eta_s/eta_s,design = f(m/m_ref).

verification.summary: Compared with a re-run of the TESPy class docstring example: 16 common variables, 0 differ at rtol=0.001, max relative deviation 3.71e-05 (v_in, from the CoolProp version); the design point agrees to 1.1e-10.
verification.reference: Example of the class docstring of TESPy src/tespy/components/turbomachinery/turbine.py (commit 19425523), re-run in a throw-away virtual environment (tespy 0.11.3.dev0 from the local clone, CoolProp 8.0.0): design P = -10452573.7 W and x = 0.9138, off-design at 28.8 t/h p_in = 88.6433 bar, eta_s = 0.8982
verification.notes: 16 common variables, 0 differ at the default tolerance rtol=1e-3; max. relative deviation 3.71e-05 (v_in, off-design), from the CoolProp version (8.0.0 in the reference run, 8.1.0dev in the CoolSolve build). The design point agrees to 1.1e-10.
